blocks.html: Contact Exotic Fish Cabo – Book Your Private Fishing Charter

Ready to book a private fishing charter in Los Cabos? Contact Exotic Fish Cabo to plan your next fishing adventure in San José del Cabo, Mexico.

We offer private fishing trips for couples, families, beginners, and experienced anglers. Whether you're interested in marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado, wahoo, or roosterfish, our team can help you choose a suitable charter based on your group size, preferences, and seasonal fishing conditions.

6-Hour Private Fishing Charters – From $350 USD per boat

A flexible option for couples and smaller groups. Starting prices apply to selected boats for 1–2 guests.

8-Hour Private Fishing Charters – From $600 USD per boat

Enjoy more time on the water exploring offshore fishing opportunities when conditions allow.

Every private fishing charter includes an experienced local captain and crew, fishing rods, reels, and basic tackle. Fishing licenses, live bait, food, drinks, transportation, and fish-cleaning services vary depending on the selected charter and must be confirmed before booking. Our team will explain all inclusions and any additional costs before your trip.

All Exotic Fish Cabo charters depart exclusively from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo. Guests staying in Cabo San Lucas are welcome, but departures do not take place from Cabo San Lucas Marina.

Our fishing trips normally depart at 6:30 AM. Final pricing depends on the selected boat, group size, and trip duration.

Contact us to check availability, compare available boats, and plan your private Cabo fishing experience.

Our Departure Location – Puerto Los Cabos Marina
